text:
maya: mini existential question: when someone writes `version: 0.0.0-beta` in YAML is that optimism or denial? 
sam: Definitive denial. Also a cry for more tests. :joy:
lina: `0.0.0-beta` is basically saying "please don't prod me" in config-speak.
build-bot: build-bot: ⚠ Build warning: version string looks like a midlife crisis. Consider MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
owen: Last week I saw `version: 'latest-ish'` and whispered a prayer. :pray: 
maya: Can we invent a semver therapist emoji? :therapist: Maybe add it to the release checklist.
sam: Also found a config that used tabs + YAML + semver like a bad band name: `v1	.	2	.	3`
lina: Please no. That's a format crime. :police_car:
omena: (not in thread) I nominate karaoke + config linting after sprint demo.
own: Karaoke night where we only sing compiler error messages. I volunteer to perform `Segmentation fault (core dumped)` as a power ballad.
sam: PR title suggestion: "fixed whitespace and my emotional baggage"
maya: Poll: who writes release notes if this turns into a taco vs sushi vs pizza decision? react with :taco:, :sushi:, or :pizza:.
build-bot: build-bot: Reaction summary will be posted in 1h.
